subject: prd/channel-inbox
statement: Where a wired agentic CLI exposes no session-start lifecycle hook, the payload-shipped operand manual shall instruct the agent to run `pyxis inbox` at session start.
rationale: no surface left dark (the fallback half of D-8)
fit_criterion: for a CLI with no session-start hook, the operand manual contains the instruction; a wired CLI ships the hook fragment instead
